title: Paycheck Calculator
description: Estimate your take-home pay per paycheck from gross pay, tax rates and deductions, annualized too.
howto: Enter your gross pay per pay period and how often you are paid.
Add your combined tax rates and any deductions.
Read your net paycheck and annual take-home.

faqs.q: What tax rate should I enter?
faqs.a: Your effective rate (total tax ÷ gross income), not your marginal bracket. Check last year's return or a recent pay stub.

faqs.q: What are pre-tax vs post-tax deductions?
faqs.a: Pre-tax (401k, health premiums) reduce taxable income; post-tax (Roth 401k, garnishments) come out after tax. The tool taxes only gross minus pre-tax.
Real payroll uses progressive brackets, Social Security/Medicare caps and state rules. This flat-rate model is for planning.
